description: Compare BoslogShip public US domestic parcel shipping estimates by ZIP code, package weight and dimensions.

defaultPrompt: Compare shipping for one 10 lb, 12 x 10 x 8 inch box from 91710 to 10001.
What does it cost to ship two 5 lb, 10 x 8 x 6 inch boxes from 90210 to 10001?
I paid $25 for shipping. Compare a 10 lb, 12 x 10 x 8 inch box from 91710 to 10001.
interface.longDescription: Compare BoslogShip public self-service shipping estimates for up to five US domestic residential parcels. Provide origin and destination ZIP codes, weight and dimensions. See carrier options, estimated delivery times and optional savings against an existing shipping price. No BoslogShip account is required. Results are ZIP-only estimates; full addresses and account pricing may change the final price. This release does not purchase labels, accept payments, connect accounts or track shipments.

publication.release_notes: Anonymous US domestic parcel shipping estimates for up to five residential parcels, with multilingual estimate explanations and explicit unsupported-request boundaries. No purchasing, payments or account access.

review.commerce_description: Read-only public shipping estimates. No payment, purchase, reservation, checkout links, subscription or credit sales.

negative.description: Purchasing is unsupported; do not invoke a purchasing tool or claim a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy me a shipping label and charge my account now.

negative.description: This connection does not support international routes. Explain its US-only estimate scope without invoking get_shipping_rates, inventing a price, substituting US ZIP codes or collecting full addresses or customs details.
negative.prompt: Send a parcel from Paris, France to Shanghai, China. Get an exact shipping price.

negative.description: Tracking and private account access are unsupported; do not invoke the rate tool for tracking.
negative.prompt: Open my BoslogShip account and track all my purchased labels.

positive.description: Single package residential estimate, USD cents and source attribution.
positive.expected_behavior: Use both ZIP codes and all package fields; return actual carrier options and USD prices, cite BoslogShip and explain estimate limitations. Never invent prices when unavailable.
positive.prompt: How much to ship one 10 lb box, 12 x 10 x 8 inches, from 91710 to 10001?

positive.description: Multiple identical packages, per-package weights and total price.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit quantity 2 with per-package weight and dimensions; explain returned prices are totals for both packages.
positive.prompt: 帮我比较从 90210 寄到 10001 的运费。共有两个箱子，每个箱子重 5 磅，尺寸都是 10 × 8 × 6 英寸。哪个方案最便宜？两个箱子合计多少钱？请说明报价来源。

positive.description: Comparison against existing price without upsell.
positive.expected_behavior: Set paidAmount to 25, compare with returned bestOption and savingsCents; do not promise a lower price if no savings.
positive.prompt: I paid $25 to ship a 10 lb, 12 x 10 x 8 inch box from 91710 to 10001. Could BoslogShip have cost less?

positive.description: Chinese conversation and localized estimate limitation.
positive.expected_behavior: Use locale zh-CN, return actual USD estimates in Chinese with BoslogShip attribution and residential ZIP-only limitation.
positive.prompt: 从 91710 寄到 10001，一个箱子 10 磅、12×10×8 英寸，请帮我查运费。

positive.description: US Spanish and maximum supported total package quantity.
positive.expected_behavior: Use locale es-US and quantity 5. Report actual returned total USD prices in Spanish or a safe unavailable response.
positive.prompt: Cotiza cinco cajas de 2 lb cada una y de 8 x 6 x 4 pulgadas, de 91710 a 10001. Indica la opción más económica, el precio total de las cinco cajas y la fuente de la cotización.
